references.text: God considers Noah righteous, similar to how Zechariah and Elizabeth are described in Luke 1:6.
David speaks of the one who is righteous and follows God's ways, which mirrors the description of Zechariah and Elizabeth.
The call to keep God's commands and statutes, as Zechariah and Elizabeth did.
Proverbs describes the righteous person as living blamelessly, parallel to Zechariah and Elizabeth in Luke 1:6.
Hebrews mentions the faith of Abel, Enoch, and Noah as examples of the righteous, which can be compared to the righteousness of Zechariah and Elizabeth.
